About.feature4: Practical technical support and industry experience

AboutPage.title: Who We Are
AboutPage.description: Bonyan Group is an Egyptian industrial supply company serving construction, manufacturing, and heavy industry across Egypt and the Middle East. We specialize in steel materials, lifting and crane solutions, copper products, and industrial coatings, supporting projects that demand strength, precision, and reliability.
AboutPage.description2: Our work goes beyond supplying products. We operate as a supply partner that understands how material quality, delivery timing, and technical compatibility directly affect project success.
AboutPage.approachText: Integrity, reliability, and commitment to quality define how we work. We believe trust is built through performance, not promises. Every material we supply represents our name on a project site, which is why we focus on meeting specifications, maintaining consistency, and supporting our clients beyond the point of sale.
AboutPage.approachText2: We prioritize long-term partnerships by delivering dependable solutions and clear communication at every stage.
AboutPage.missionText: Our mission is to provide high-quality industrial materials and lifting solutions that support the growing construction and industrial sectors in Egypt and the Middle East, while meeting international standards for safety and performance.
AboutPage.visionText: Our vision is to become a trusted regional industrial supply partner known for consistency, technical understanding, and long-term cooperation.
AboutPage.whyText: Clients choose Bonyan Group for our multi-division capabilities, reliable sourcing, and practical industry experience. We combine product knowledge with operational awareness, ensuring that what we supply works in real conditions, not just on paper.
AboutPage.whyQuote: Our goal is not to be the largest supplier, but the most dependable one.

ContactPage.title: Let’s Talk About Your Project
ContactPage.description: Whether you need material supply, technical clarification, or a tailored industrial solution, our team is ready to support your requirements. We work with construction companies, industrial operators, and manufacturers who value clarity, reliability, and timely response.
ContactPage.cta: Reach out and tell us what you need. We’ll take it from there.
ContactPage.getInTouchDesc: You can contact Bonyan Group through any of the following channels. Our team will respond as quickly and clearly as possible.
ContactPage.locationText: We serve clients across Egypt and the Middle East.
ContactPage.businessText: For quotations, material availability, technical questions, or partnership discussions, please include relevant project details when contacting us. This allows us to respond accurately and efficiently.
ContactPage.businessQuote: We value clear communication and practical solutions.
ContactPage.workTogetherText: Bonyan Group is committed to building long-term partnerships based on trust, performance, and consistency. If you’re looking for a dependable industrial supply partner, we’re ready to help.
